tool_args.rationale: The first fitted mechanism failed confirmation, but the verified W3 bridge maps to the inland-hub two-layer siphon. Its saturating u response and sink-gradient dependence match the paid rows, including the open-branch contrast. Fit vmax, rho, and positive-open-branch c_loc numerically across all seven observations; no oscillatory signature or long-horizon ambiguity is indicated.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing seven observations already vary s_grad independently and identify the stated siphon's three fitted parameters; another acquisition is unnecessary.
Those notes require a longer trajectory and at least eight rows; observed signature and present sweep support the simpler static two-layer siphon.

considered_alternatives.option: Repeat the saturated supply-gradient coupling model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation strongly refuted that model (RMSE 1.206 versus tolerance 0.045); the prior execution error was a code-scope bug, not scientific refutation of the siphon.
